A '''temple''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] served as the final sanctuary of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], hosting his injured spirit after the [[Dromund Kaas operation|loss of his host body]]. The Emperor's agents were supposed to use a [[Temple of Sacrifice artifact|artifact]] in the nearby [[Temple of Sacrifice]] to consume all life on the moon and funnel it to the Emperor, thus restoring his strength, but the [[Imperial Guard]] were slaughtered by the [[Order of Revan]], and [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] attempt to use the artifact himself&mdash;hoping to restore the Emperor so that he could be permanently killed&mdash;failed due to the intervention of the [[Yavin Coalition|allied]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Determined to end the Emperor nonetheless, Revan fled to the Emperor's resting place, but was defeated in [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] in the temple's courtyard. The Emperor, having fed off of the [[Death/Legends|death]] and chaos sown by the ongoing battle against the Revanites, was able to regain his strength and departed the moon without taking a physical form.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />
